task: publish a post to social media (Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok): compose the post — text, photo, or clip — add caption and tags, preview how it will look to the audience, publish, and verify it is live; complete when the published post is visible on the profile or feed. Surface pinned: a social platform's posting flow on app or web. Variants: direct messages, editing the video/photo content itself, and growth or algorithm advice do not belong.

tree.label: Publish a post on a social platform
tree.note: do 1 where the platform is new - one keeper installs and registers, the other eleven arrive installed and signed in. then 2; 2.2 re-enters mid-task when the first composer falls short (T1et). 3 then 4 for media posts - except 4.2 runs before 3.2 when the sound must be laid first (rjjj); text posts skip both (MzVy, e4rd, VTiv, 8wOt). 5 where the platform treats the upload as a titled video asset (L9bf, PXXs, MzVy, T1et). 6 and 7 in any order the composer allows - the corpus works them as a hub, opening most options and keeping few. then 8; 9 when a live post exists - four keepers end without one. another post loops back to 2.4 (rjjj's upload pass; MzVy runs the loop once per post type).

children.label: Get onto the platform
